title: Hessian
description: config.ini [Hessian] section (HessianConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

phva_atoms.description: PHVA mobile/active atoms displaced in the Hessian FD (not free/fixed): comma-delimited indices, e.g. 0,1,2, or 'All' for every free atom.

zero_freq_value.description: The value assigned to zero frequencies.

fd_scheme.description: Finite-difference stencil of the assembled Hessian and of the Lanczos and Davidson Hessian-vector products: one_sided, central, or fourth (fourth_order, central4). min_mode_method = xtsci takes forward differences for one_sided and central differences for central and fourth.

write_modes.description: Write every normal mode to modes.con: the Cartesian mode as a displacements section, with its eigenvalue, hbar omega and wavenumber as frame metadata.
